research.topic: Using the Newcastle vs Everton football hype to teach exam‑stress‑management for Indian high‑school students
verified: Sharing a team chant or mantra may increase motivation by enhancing social connection and reducing perceived stress.

sources.title: Investigating social connection as a protective factor against exam stress in college students.

research.hook: Wish I knew earlier that a match‑day mindset could save you during exams
research.tip: Match‑Day Focus Sprint: 5‑min warm‑up, 25‑min focused study, 5‑min half‑time break, repeat, then a 15‑min post‑match review
dropped: Acute stress spikes cortisol, impairing short‑term memory retrieval (WHO 2023). (unsupported)

data.title: Exam Stress? Newcastle vs Everton Hype Se Study Ka Gameplan
data.title_en: Use Football Hype to Beat Exam Stress

scenes.text: Kya tum match‑day josh se exams crack kar sakte?
scenes.text_en: Can you crack exams with match‑day energy?

scenes.text: Newcastle vs Everton ka hype har hallway mein baj raha hai.
scenes.text_en: The Newcastle‑Everton hype is echoing in every hallway.

scenes.text: Riya, Delhi ki 12th board student, bhi is josh ka use karti hai.
scenes.text_en: Riya, a 12th‑grade board student from Delhi, also uses this excitement.

scenes.text: Pehle 5 minute warm‑up, favorite chant gaao (screen par chant likha dikhao).
scenes.text_en: First, do a 5‑minute warm‑up and sing a chant (show chant text on screen).

scenes.text: Phir 15 minute deep study, phone silent mode.
scenes.text_en: Then, 15 minutes of deep study with phone on silent.

scenes.text: Uske baad 10 minute quick review, notes ko summarize karo.
scenes.text_en: After that, a 10‑minute quick review, summarize your notes.

scenes.text: Half‑time break: 5 minute walk, hydrate, reset.
Team chant share karne se motivation badhta, stress kam hota.
scenes.text_en: Sharing a team chant boosts motivation and lowers stress.

scenes.text: Tip: Har study sprint ke baad ek key takeaway likho, yaad rakhne ke liye.
scenes.text_en: Tip: Write one key takeaway after each study sprint to reinforce memory.

scenes.text: Warm‑up, study sprint, break, chant – har subject ke liye repeat karo.
scenes.text_en: Warm‑up, study sprint, break, chant – repeat for each subject.

scenes.text: Aaj se ‘Match‑Day Focus Sprint’ ko try karo!
scenes.text_en: Start trying this ‘Match‑Day Focus Sprint’ today!

data.description: A short reel showing how the excitement of a Newcastle vs Everton match can be turned into a powerful study routine for Indian high‑schoolers, using warm‑up chants and timed study sprints to cut exam stress.
